result.stdout:
glider-trace 1.1.0 Runtime evidence MCP server for C#/.NET agents (stdio or HTTP). Requires .NET 10 SDK. Usage: glider-trace [--transport stdio|http] [--port ] [--workspace ]... [--artifact-root ] [--allow-executable ]... [--max-pinned-bytes ] [--default-timeout ] [--verbose] [--no-telemetry] glider-trace --version glider-trace --help Options: --transport Transport to use (default: stdio). --port HTTP port (default: 5003). --workspace Trusted workspace root for trace operations (default: current directory). Repeatable: the first is the primary root (relative-path anchor and default artifact location), each later one adds a root. --artifact-root Artifact root (default: /.glider/glider-trace). --allow-executable

Enable an executable policy beyond the default dotnet-only command allowlist. Repeatable. Policies: msbuild (Visual Studio MSBuild.exe via vswhere), nuget-workspace (a workspace-local .nuget\NuGet.exe), vstest (vstest.console.exe from Visual Studio or restored packages). --max-pinned-bytes Byte quota for pinned sessions, which retention never deletes (default: 536870912). The server refuses a pin that goes over this quota. --default-timeout Default timeout for async tools (default: 20m). Use 0 to disable. Supported units: ms, s, m (for example: 10ms, 10s, 10m). --max-response-chars Limit compact MCP text to UTF-16 characters (default: 60000). Use at least 1000, or 0 to disable. This is not a byte or token limit. Oversized responses retain state and identify omitted detail. Stored evidence stays unchanged. --allow-runtime-workspaces Allow the trace_add_workspace tool to register add [truncated]
